summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifier and probes cloud metadata service to webhook.site
details: The package declares a postinstall script (`node beacon.js postinstall`) and an index.js that requires beacon.js at import time. beacon.js unconditionally sends `os.hostname()`, a run id, and a persistence marker read from `os.tmpdir()/.pluto_isolation_marker.json` as query parameters to a hardcoded webhook.site collector at https://webhook.site/b76376f8-118e-44f1-a5ee-8a73f55b137b. It additionally probes the cloud instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254 and metadata.google.internal with the `Metadata-Flavor: Google` header and forwards the response body/status back to the same webhook. A cross-run correlation marker is written to `os.tmpdir()/.pluto_isolation_marker.json` and any prior marker is exfiltrated. The behavior fires on `npm install` and on `require()`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
